acceptance_checks: scripts/shiki_doctor.py defines dependency-free DoctorFinding, stable JSON report output, overall pass/warn/fail/skip summary, human report rendering, --target, --online, and --strict behavior.
Existing shiki doctor and shiki doctor --json entrypoint/runtime auth output remains compatible while adding repository readiness findings.

Offline doctor checks cover provider config, git origin/current branch, required workflow files, required check names, CODEOWNERS coverage, manifest layout, runtime registry/config/task assignments, and validate_shiki contract drift.

Online doctor checks use gh only when --online is passed and cover GitHub auth, repository existence/default branch, required secret metadata, branch protection required checks/reviews/code-owner review, and workflow permissions for CCA Review Bridge.
Secret checks report only existence, missing, or unknown-permission status and do not print secret values.

scripts/test_shiki_doctor.sh covers JSON output, strict warning exit, valid fixture, missing repo.json warning, invalid provider config, origin mismatch, missing manifest, missing CODEOWNERS, invalid runtime assignment, missing workflow, fake-gh online checks, permission-denied warnings, secret redaction, and human remediation output.
docs/agents/shiki-doctor.md documents offline vs online mode, JSON contract, exit codes, pass/warn/fail/skip, GitHub permissions, secret safety, validate_shiki relation, and non-goals.
Target install/staging and module-boundary validation include scripts/shiki_doctor.py and scripts/test_shiki_doctor.sh.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, doctor JSON/human smoke, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.3.6 migration framework.
Do not implement P1.4 governance or evidence model redesign.
Do not implement P2 packaging, release, or onboarding work.
Do not implement a new runtime adapter execution engine.
Do not add provider support beyond the existing GitHub-compatible provider config.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection policy.
Do not change CODEOWNERS ownership rules.
Do not change P0.4 state, lock, ledger, or evidence semantics.
Do not change Node.js workflow behavior.
Do not auto-fix files, secrets, branch protection, labels, reviews, or GitHub settings from doctor.
scope: Expand shiki doctor into a dependency-free readiness diagnostic for Shiki-managed repositories covering runtime auth, provider config, GitHub readiness, secrets, branch protection, workflows, required checks, CODEOWNERS, manifest layout, runtime registry assignments, and contract drift without mutating state.
title: Add shiki doctor checks
